principle: Render real official LDraw geometry. Promote only claims supported by geometry, official metadata, grid arithmetic, or an already-compiled shortcut. Visual adjacency is never a click.

tests.title: Complete house is already an assembly
tests.question: Does one official shortcut really compile a building-sized subtree rather than merely resembling a house?

assertions.label: shortcut contains at least 8 placed child references

tests.title: Garage and garage door are a native pair
tests.question: Can the bench distinguish a documented native mating relation from a merely plausible pairing?

assertions.label: both official headers explicitly name the other as the fitting mate

tests.title: 32-stud road modules orchestrate on a real grid
tests.question: Can repeated world chunks be placed by their actual LDraw pitch rather than eyeballing a scene?

assertions.label: each module measures approximately 640 x 640 LDU
serialized centers are exactly one 32-stud module apart

tests.title: Shared family is not yet a solved stair joint
tests.question: Will the bench refuse to call two staircase-family pieces assembled when no exact relative transform has been promoted?

assertions.label: family resemblance cannot promote a click

tests.title: Wet fixtures need a plumbing adapter grammar
tests.question: Will the bench keep geometric placement separate from water-system compatibility?

assertions.label: bathtub, shower and tap all parse as real geometry
rendering together does not invent a fluid connection

tests.title: Forklift imports a complete machine subtree
tests.question: Can the bench recognize a complete operational machine shortcut before rebuilding its mast and chassis from primitives?

assertions.label: complete machine contains multiple explicit child references
shortcut contains its forklift rail/mast assembly
